items.title: Tech Reviewer & Consumer Electronics Expert
items.biography: Marques Brownlee, known as MKBHD, is a prominent tech reviewer and content creator specializing in consumer electronics. His YouTube channel features in-depth reviews, comparisons, and demonstrations of smartphones, gadgets, and emerging technologies. Based in NYC, he collaborates with brands and celebrities, producing high-quality videos that educate and entertain a global audience. His content often includes durability tests, camera reviews, and insights into the latest tech trends.

items.title: AI Innovator and Productivity Enhancer
items.biography: Grok is an AI-focused content creator known for showcasing AI features, tools, and integrations across various platforms. The content primarily revolves around AI capabilities, automation, and productivity enhancements, often highlighting new updates, connectors, and applications in daily workflows. Grok also shares creative uses of AI, such as video editing and storytelling, targeting tech-savvy users and professionals looking to leverage AI for efficiency and innovation.

items.title: Tech Reviewer and Content Creator
items.biography: iJustine is a prominent tech reviewer and content creator known for her in-depth reviews and showcases of the latest gadgets, gaming products, and tech innovations. She frequently covers major tech events like CES, sharing insights and first looks at cutting-edge technology. Her content spans across platforms including YouTube, TikTok, and Twitter, where she engages with a global audience interested in tech, gaming, and lifestyle. iJustine also collaborates with major brands and participates in product promotions, often highlighting her signature pink-themed tech accessories.

items.title: Zack Nelson (JerryRigEverything): In-Depth Tech Teardowns & DIY Builds
items.biography: Tech reviewer and DIY inventor Zack Nelson, known as JerryRigEverything, performs in-depth gadget teardowns, durability tests, and hands-on builds. He creates across YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram, runs EcoFlow brand partnerships, and showcases mobility-tech projects like accessible wheelchairs. Content focuses on consumer electronics, prototyping, and practical engineering insights that appeal to tech enthusiasts and makers.

items.title: Apple Senior Vice President of Marketing
items.biography: Greg Joswiak is Apple's Senior Vice President of Marketing, known for promoting Apple's hardware, software, and services integration. His content focuses on product announcements, event updates, and educational posts about Apple's latest innovations, often highlighting features like Final Cut Pro, AirPods, and Safari. He frequently engages with the developer community, shares insights on accessibility, and celebrates Apple's milestones, such as WWDC and Apple's 50th anniversary.

items.title: AI Educator and Deep Learning Pioneer
items.biography: Andrew Ng is a prominent figure in the field of artificial intelligence, known for his roles as the co-founder of Coursera, founder of DeepLearning.AI, and executive chairman of LandingAI. He is also an adjunct faculty member at Stanford University and has previously led AI initiatives at Baidu and Google Brain. Ng's online presence is heavily focused on AI education, with frequent posts promoting new courses and sharing insights on AI advancements. His content often covers topics such as machine learning, deep learning, and agentic AI, and he collaborates with various organizations and experts to deliver educational content. Ng's work is aimed at both professionals and enthusiasts in the AI community, with a strong emphasis on practical applications and skill development.

items.title: Founder of Figure and Archer Aviation
items.biography: Brett Adcock is a technology entrepreneur and founder of Figure, an AI Robotics company developing general-purpose humanoid robots. He also founded Cover, an AI security company focused on concealed weapon detection in schools, and Archer Aviation, an aerospace company building electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft. Adcock frequently shares updates on robotics advancements, AI challenges, and industry insights across platforms like LinkedIn and Twitter. His content often showcases technological innovations, company milestones, and thought leadership in AI and robotics.

items.title: AI & Software Engineer
items.biography: Thariq is a software engineer and former Y Combinator W20 participant, previously associated with the MIT Media Lab. He focuses on AI and software development, particularly around Claude Code, sharing updates, technical insights, and tutorials. His content includes feature announcements, coding practices, and live demos aimed at developers and engineers.

items.title: Cryptocurrency Scam Investigator
items.biography: ZachXBT is a cryptocurrency investigator and advisor at Paradigm, known for uncovering scams, fraud, and security incidents in the crypto space. He shares detailed analyses of thefts, fraud cases, and security vulnerabilities, often tracing stolen funds and exposing malicious actors. His content focuses on educating the crypto community, warning against scams, and providing insights into high-profile incidents. ZachXBT’s work has led to legal actions and recoveries, making him a trusted figure in cryptocurrency security.

items.title: Chief Scientist at OpenAI
items.biography: Jakub Pachocki is the Chief Scientist at OpenAI, focusing on advanced AI research and development. His online presence primarily revolves around sharing insights into AI capabilities, reasoning models, and frontier research. He frequently discusses the performance of AI systems in competitive programming challenges and emphasizes the importance of interpretability and faithfulness in AI design. Pachocki's posts often highlight OpenAI's internal projects and their applications in solving complex problems, reflecting his deep involvement in cutting-edge AI technologies.
